Jai, a peaceful man who does not like violence, decides to take revenge on a drug mafia don when he kills his sister. He must fight to protect himself and his family.
Movie:- Shera (1999) | shera
Starcast:- Mithun Chakraborty, Vinitha, Gulshan Grover, Asrani
Directed By:- T.L.V. Prasad
Produced By:- Rajiv Babbar
Music By:- Anand-Milind
